requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest on the charge to be expunged, if known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest on the charge to be expunged, if known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest that created the record, taken from the case papers if it is known

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the agency that made the arrest on the charge to be expunged
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the agency that made the arrest on the charge to be expunged
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant can obtain, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that made the arrest, taken from the case papers - the clerk of the court that disposed of the charge can help you locate it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Specific charge to be expunged, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Specific charge to be expunged, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the specific charge the other person incurred using your name or identification, worded exactly as the court record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption - the court that disposed of the charge, and its city or county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption - the court that disposed of the charge, and its city or county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform has not seen the record another person's use of the participant's identity created, so the disposing court is the participant's to establish
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the court that disposed of the charge, and its city or county - the clerk's office of that locality's circuit court can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Disposition of the charge, and the date of final disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Disposition of the charge, and the date of final disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the charge ended and on what date, checked against the case file and your CCRE record - correct the packet if they disagree

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Full name shown on the record to be expunged, exactly as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Full name shown on the record to be expunged, exactly as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the record was created by another person's use of the participant's identity, and its exact wording is on the record, not in the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the full name printed on the record to be expunged, copied exactly - the record's own wording controls, and the clerk of the court that disposed of the charge holds the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of how your name or identification came to be used when someone else was arrested or charged
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of how your name or identification came to be used when someone else was arrested or charged
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the participant's own account and asserts nothing about a third party's conduct
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of how your name or identification came to be used - the packet asserts nothing about who committed any offence, so these lines are yours alone

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the charge to be expunged, if one appears on the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the charge to be expunged, if one appears on the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the charge to be expunged, copied from the court record if one appears there

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of dismissal of the charge
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of dismissal of the charge
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date the charge was dismissed, taken from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the dismissed charge
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the dismissed charge
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the dismissed charge, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Charge that was dismissed, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Charge that was dismissed, worded exactly as the court record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no charge fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the dismissed charge, worded exactly as the court record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption of the motion - the court that dismissed the charge, and its city or county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption of the motion - the court that dismissed the charge, and its city or county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: Va. Code Sec. 19.2-392.2(H) routes this motion to the dismissing court, and which court that is lives on the participant's record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the court that dismissed the charge, and its city or county - use this motion only if that court found you were not the person named in the charging document

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the attorney for the Commonwealth
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the attorney for the Commonwealth
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the attorney for the Commonwealth and the participant writes it before service
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the attorney for the Commonwealth for the county or city where you file - the circuit court clerk can give it to you
